SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Sequence number assigned by the issuer to each proposed amendment of the undertaking.

DateOfIssuance.name: Date Of Issuance
DateOfIssuance.definition: Date on which the proposed amendment is issued.

AdvisingParty.name: Advising Party
AdvisingParty.definition: Party asked to advise the proposed amendment to the beneficiary or to another advising party at the request of the issuer.

SecondAdvisingParty.name: Second Advising Party
SecondAdvisingParty.definition: Additional party asked to advise the proposed amendment.

TerminationDetails.name: Termination Details
TerminationDetails.definition: Details concerning the requested termination of the undertaking.

UndertakingAmountAdjustment.name: Undertaking Amount Adjustment
UndertakingAmountAdjustment.definition: Requested increase or decrease to the amount of for the undertaking.

NewExpiryDetails.name: New Expiry Details
NewExpiryDetails.definition: Requested new expiry terms for the undertaking.

NewBeneficiary.name: New Beneficiary
NewBeneficiary.definition: Requested new beneficiary of the undertaking.

NewUndertakingTermsAndConditions.name: New Undertaking Terms And Conditions
NewUndertakingTermsAndConditions.definition: Requested new terms and conditions of the undertaking.

LocalUndertaking.name: Local Undertaking
LocalUndertaking.definition: Amendment details related to the local undertaking.

BeneficiaryConsentRequestIndicator.name: Beneficiary Consent Request Indicator
BeneficiaryConsentRequestIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not consent is requested from the beneficiary.

DeliveryChannel.name: Delivery Channel
DeliveryChannel.definition: Communication channel for delivery of the proposed amendment.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the proposed amendment.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the proposed amendment.
